entry.hypothesis: H2 - an equal-weight book that holds each ETF only while it trades above its 6-12 month moving average (else BIL) has a shallower drawdown and a higher Sharpe than holding the universe.
entry.rationale: Faber 2007 tactical asset allocation - the moving-average filter is a trend signal (Levine-Pedersen 2016) that steps out of extended bear markets; registered as trend-family (same mechanism as H1, different signal construction).

pbo.caveat: only 4 trials — at this width the estimate has a standard deviation around 0.2-0.3 even when the true value is 0.5, so read it as a direction, not a number. Values between 0.2 and 0.8 do not distinguish a real edge from noise here.

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
